items.exampleEn: The strong wind ripped the flag in half.

items.audioEn: The kitchen sink won't drain, so I've called a plumber to come this afternoon.
items.audioZh: 廚房水槽不排水，所以我已經找了水電工今天下午來。

options: A plumber broke the kitchen light
The dirty water stays where it is

items.sentenceEn: Hold on to the rail and keep a firm grip as the boat moves.
items.sentenceZh: 船在晃動時，抓住欄杆並握緊。

items.sentenceEn: Plants suck up water through their roots.

items.stemEn: Be careful not to ____ the paper when you open the envelope.
items.stemZh: 打開信封時小心別把紙撕破。

items.stemEn: The train service was ____ for two hours because of heavy snow.
items.stemZh: 火車因為大雪暫停行駛兩個小時。

items.passageEn: Last month, I joined a weekend woodcarving class at the community center. The teacher, Mr. Ho, showed us how to grip the knife firmly and carve slowly, always moving the blade away from the body. On the first day, I ripped my sleeve on a sharp corner of the table, but nobody laughed. The class was held in an old kitchen, and we hung our coats on metal hooks above the old sink. After each class, we had to drain the water from the cleaning bucket. During the third lesson, the lights went out, and the class was suspended for half an hour. Mr. Ho praised the originality of my design, which really boosted my confidence. Now I am carving a small bird for my mother.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我參加了活動中心的週末木雕課。老師何先生示範怎麼牢牢握住刀子、慢慢地雕，刀刃總是朝外、遠離身體。第一天，我的袖子被桌子尖尖的角勾破了，但沒有人笑我。上課地點是一間舊廚房，我們把外套掛在舊水槽上方的金屬掛鉤上。每次下課後，我們都得把清潔水桶裡的水倒掉。第三堂課時停電了，課程暫停了半個小時。何老師稱讚我的設計很有原創性，這真的讓我更有信心。現在我正在雕一隻小鳥要送給媽媽。

questions.questionZh: 第三堂課發生了什麼事？
options: 老師帶大家去公園寫生

items.promptZh: 這個廣告讓我們的銷售額提升了兩成。
referenceEn: This advertisement boosted our sales by twenty percent.
Our sales rose by twenty percent thanks to the boost from this ad.
rubricZh: 「兩成」可寫，例如 twenty percent、20% 等
時態合理（例如 boosted、rose 等）

referenceEn: Dad carved the roast chicken at the table.
My father carved the roast chicken at the dinner table.
rubricZh: carve 這裡指「切（肉）」（例如 carved the roast chicken 等）
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 carved、carves 等）
